result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign or Signable**\. The best choice depends on how many contracts you send, how much you want to spend and whether you need anything beyond collecting signatures.

If you're operating in the UK, I'd put **Signable** particularly high on the shortlist because it's UK-based and has pricing designed around business document volumes.

## My top 5 e-signature platforms for small businesses

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for simplicity)

- Very easy to use.
- Straightforward document signing and tracking.
- Good integrations with Dropbox and other business tools.
- Ideal for everyday contracts and agreements.

Indicative pricing: from around \$15/month.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall)

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Strong audit trails and security features.
- Excellent integrations.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.

Indicative pricing: from around \$11–15/month for entry-level plans.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Signable**

(Best UK option)

- UK-based e-signature provider.
- Unlimited users on its account-based plans.
- Pay-as-you-go option available.
- Good for small businesses sending a moderate number of contracts.

Indicative pricing: around £31/month for its Small plan.

[Visit Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

- Excellent for proposals, quotes and contracts.
- Create professional-looking documents.
- Track when customers open and view documents.
- Particularly good for sales-driven businesses.

Indicative pricing: free entry option; paid plans from around \$19/user/month.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Logo Wordmark PNG Vector - BrandLogo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/95na-wLQUN9p7GmfVbVlsMH9WIm3-bHOmsuOzR4w7FH_LNHajHgaUKajbYSFfuQalq9gsQjPtmcFPYYjJQoXKBtI8uyMeQC8oBjmdwkaHvf0cQn2ZgYIR22CA9JGfELZMa-MGbcgzYfhWePcbsbIj2Mlr0RTRu05Ww7rIP3mtZmaOkamqppjBubOBDVYwJ7W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent PDF editing and signing.
- Useful document management features.
- Strong integration with Microsoft and Adobe products.
- Best if you already use Adobe Acrobat.

Indicative pricing: from around \$17/user/month for team Acrobat plans.

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-signature.html)

## Quick comparison

| Platform | Best suited to | My verdict |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Everyday signing | Very easy |
| DocuSign | Professional contracts | Excellent |
| Signable | UK small businesses | Excellent |
| PandaDoc | Quotes and proposals | Excellent |
| Adobe Sign | PDF-heavy businesses | Very good |


## What I'd look for before choosing

For a small business, I'd prioritise\:

- Legally valid electronic signatures in the UK.
- Automatic reminders for customers who haven't signed.
- A full audit trail showing who signed and when.
- Templates for frequently used contracts.
- Unlimited or reasonably priced signature requests.
- Easy signing from a mobile phone.
- Multiple employees being able to send documents.
